name: Kalimba
description: A 17-key kalimba with bell-like tines. Slide across them for a glissando, or learn songs as the next note lights up.
prompt: A kalimba with the standard 17-tine layout and a bell-like sound, glissando by sliding, a key selector, and songs like Twinkle Twinkle, Ode to Joy and Happy Birthday that you can learn note by note or listen to.
author: gonzaroman
